content:
[L] high | bottom of right Copilot panel | The "Suggested reply" text ("[Drafted by SupportOS Copilot... review before sending.]") is clipped at the panel's bottom edge with no composer strip visible — the reply/composer area is either missing or runs beneath the Copilot panel entirely.
[L] high | bottom strip vs right panel | There is no bottom reply/composer strip at all; the composer region is truncated/absent, so the reading pane has no send affordance and the Copilot card collides with the window edge.
[S] high | conversation list, row #502 | Row #502's subject "…data erasure request - …" is truncated with an ellipsis while row #501 shows full text; inconsistent truncation with no consistent width handling.
[S] med | reading pane | No reading pane content is visible for the selected conversation #501 — the Copilot panel occupies the entire right side, so the actual message thread appears missing or pushed off-screen.
[C] high | overall composition | The three-column layout is unbalanced: a wide empty Views rail with four dead items, a crushed middle list, and a right panel that consumes ~45% of width while the actual conversation content is nowhere visible.
[H] med | Copilot panel | Bulleted summary lines are cut mid-thought with duplicated near-identical bullets ("How do I give them full access…" appears twice) — reads like raw debug output, not curated content.
[S] med | search/filter row, list header | The search field ("search conver…"), the "#" chip, and the Apply button have uneven gaps and inconsistent heights; "Filters" and "Reset" labels float loosely with no control grouping.
[H] med | Copilot panel footer | The bracketed draft note sits at near-equal visual weight to the suggested reply body, mixing metadata with primary content.
[C] med | Copilot panel | The "Signals" card and "Summary" card have different widths and inset margins (Signals card narrower than Summary card), an inconsistent card treatment.
[S] low | Views rail | Counter values (2/0/0/2) are inconsistently spaced from labels; "All 2" appears flush right while items look like placeholder stubs.
[H] low | conversation list rows | Row metadata (email, timestamp) and status chip sit at similar weight to subject line; hierarchy between sender/subject/status is weak.
[C] low | right panel top-right | A stray cursor arrow floats over the panel near the close X, adding visual noise.

VERDICT: unprofessional — the composer is clipped out of existence, the conversation thread is missing, and the layout reads like an unfinished debug harness.
